content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education Studies Study organisation Financing your studies Financing your studies Table of contents Counselling service at Studierendenwerk Berlin Accommodation Scholarships Working alongside your studies Educational support allowance (BAföG) Student loans Help in financial emergencies Counselling service at Studierendenwerk Berlin The social counselling service of the StudierendenWERK Berlin offers advice and support in matters of student finance and accommodation. Consultation times and events are listed in the events calendar . Accommodation We have compiled tips on finding accommodation and information on halls of residence, shared accommodation, rental costs and support options for you. Scholarships This section contains an overview of scholarship programmes and a list of liaison lecturers at HTW Berlin. Working alongside your studies The Career Services at HTW Berlin help you with your job search. Jobangebote can be found on the HTW Berlin job vacancies page (“Stellenticket”), and job vacancies advertisements for student assistants are posted on the university website. Information on part-time jobs from the Studierendenwerk Berlin and, for international students specifically , from the German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD) Educational support allowance (BAföG) BAföG is the most important state student grant, the level of which depends on the income of parents and students. Application advice and submission takes place via the Studierendenwerk Berlin. Student loans Student loans can be applied for during advanced studies and must be repaid. It is advisable to check your financial situation carefully before taking out a loan and apply for a social counselling session from the Studierendenwerk Berlin . Help in financial emergencies Students in acute financial crisis can receive support from the StudierendenWERK Berlin or from social counselling centres.
